title: Hallucination-Aware Multi-Agent RAG via Internal Attention Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.35056v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds language models in retrieved evidence, but its outputs often contain claims unsupported by that evidence. Recent multi-agent RAG systems decompose the pipeline into cooperative decisions, yet they typically optimize all agents under a shared task reward such as EM or F1, which measures answer overlap rather than faithfulness to evidence. We propose a hallucination-aware multi-agent RAG framework that combines the task reward with an internal hallucination-risk signal computed from the generator's attention-head norms. Three role-specific LoRA adapters, a query planner, an evidence selector, and an answer generator, share a frozen backbone. A lightweight critic is trained once on TruthfulQA truthful/false pairs and then kept frozen, providing a complementary risk score that is added to the shared reward during cooperative PPO training. translated_title: 基于内部注意力奖励的幻觉感知多智能体检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）将语言模型建立在检索到的证据之上，但其输出常常包含证据无法支持的声明。近期的多智能体RAG系统将整个流程分解为多个协作决策，然而它们通常在共享的任务奖励（如EM或F1）下优化所有智能体，这类奖励衡量的是答案的重叠程度，而非对证据的忠实性。我们提出了一种幻觉感知的多智能体RAG框架，将任务奖励与从生成器注意力头范数计算得出的内部幻觉风险信号相结合。三个角色特定的LoRA适配器——查询规划器、证据选择器和答案生成器——共享一个冻结的主干网络。一个轻量级评论家模型仅在TruthfulQA的真实/虚假样本对上训练一次后即保持冻结，提供一个互补的风险评分，并在协作PPO训练过程中将该评分加入共享奖励中。在三个主干模型（Qwen3-8B、Llama3-8B、Llama2-13B）上……
tldr: 该论文提出一种幻觉感知的多智能体RAG框架，通过从生成器注意力头范数中提取内部幻觉风险信号并与共享任务奖励结合，在协作PPO训练中有效提升生成答案对检索证据的忠实性。
